Check whether the document is really a credit note or an invoice, and confirm the agreed price on PO-ITNDCZAREF before deciding anything.","email_subject": "Clarification needed for Invoice NdC90426 (PO-ITNDCZAREF)","email_body": "Dear Kransberg Tyre & Parts (Pty) Ltd team,

Thank you for your document NdC90426, dated 2026-03-17, for a total of 3907.52 ZAR, referencing PO-ITNDCZAREF.

We have two points to clarify before we can process it:

1. Document type: The document is labelled as a credit note. Could you confirm whether it is a credit note or an invoice?
2. Pricing: The line "Pallet strapping kit" (quantity 1) is billed at 3397.84, while the purchase order price is 3058.06. Could you confirm the correct unit price? If the billed price is correct, please let us know the reason for the difference. If it is an error, please send a corrected invoice.

Once we receive your confirmation or a corrected document, we will review it further. Please note that this message does not confirm approval or payment.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
